name: AAA Daily Advantage Visa Signature® Credit Card

localized_names.en: AAA Daily Advantage Visa Signature® Credit Card

apr.notes: Annual Percentage Rate (APR) for Purchases: 17.49% to 31.49%, based upon your creditworthiness. This APR will vary with the market based on the Prime Rate. APR for Balance Transfers: 17.49% to 31.49%. APR for Cash Advances: 32.49%. Minimum Interest Charge: $3.00. Balance Transfer Fee: Either $10 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater. Cash Advance Fee: Either $10.00 or 5.0% of the amount of each cash advance, whichever is greater. Late Payment Fee: Up to $41.00. Returned Payment Fee: Up to $41.00.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign Transaction: None. 0% Foreign transaction fees.

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash Back can be redeemed as Statement Credits, Direct Deposit, Rewards and qualifying purchases at participating AAA locations. Cash back rewards will expire 5 years after the date that they are posted to your Cash Back balance.

signup_bonus.description: Start earning today with a $100 statement credit after you spend $1,000 on your card in the first 90 days of account opening.
